scenarios.name: Hero Section Display and Branding
scenarios.description: Verify that the hero section displays project name, logo, and tagline prominently as specified in REQ-1

steps.description: Navigate to the homepage URL
steps.context: Starting state of the page load test

steps.description: Check that project name, logo, and tagline are visible in the hero section
steps.context: First viewport should contain all hero elements without scrolling

steps.description: Verify tagline clearly explains MirDB is a persistent key-value store with Memcached protocol support
steps.context: Users should understand the project purpose within 10 seconds

test_cases.expected: Project name 'MirDB' is prominently displayed
Project logo (logo.gif) is loaded and visible
Tagline clearly explains persistent key-value store with Memcached protocol support
